title: VRAM budget math: weights, activations, caches
hook: Three different things want room on your card. Each has its own formula, and only one of them is the size of the file.

verified.claim: The working memory estimate is area × dtype size × 0.01 × memory_usage_factor MB, with area = batch × the latent's spatial sizes and channels left out.
estimate_memory passes twice the batch, for the conditional and unconditional passes.
load_models_gpu asks for total model size × 1.1 + max(inference memory, memory_required + reserved).
memory_usage_factor is 1.0 for SD15, 0.8 for SDXL and 1.6 for SD3.
Finished results between nodes live on the CPU unless --gpu-only.
The U-Net sizes, 860M and 2.6B parameters, are in Table 1 of the SDXL paper.

unchecked: The estimate is ComfyUI's own and its source carries the comment that it needs tweaking. We did not compare it with a measured peak on a real card.
Many models override the estimate or use other factors. We read only the base method and the factors named here.
